scenarios.name: Bull – AI Ethernet Champion
scenarios.notes: Ethernet becomes default AI fabric; Arista is leading AI Ethernet vendor with strong AI share, solid classic DC growth, and accelerating campus; margins stay best-in-class.

scenarios.name: Base – Strong but Shared AI Winner
scenarios.notes: AI networking is large but shared among ANET/NVDA/Cisco/ODMs; classic DC grows ~10–12%; campus grows mid-teens; margins normalize slightly below peak but remain strong.

revenueBuild.label: AI fabrics (scale-out + scale-across, EtherLink)
sources: TAM $40-50B 2030 (thesis, secondary forecasts); cross-check: FY2026 AI fabrics goal >=$3.5B (Q2'26 call, CFO Breithaupt) => 27% CAGR to 2030; scale-across TAM alone $15-20B by 2030 (Q2'26 call, Ullal)

revenueBuild.label: Core DC frontend + routing adjacencies
sources: FY2026 base derived: $12.6B guide (Q2'26 call) - $3.5B AI - $1.25B campus - ~$1.65B service; FY2025 product $7,576.9M (10-K s_0012_c09)

scenarios.name: Bear – Capex Hangover & Competition Bite
scenarios.notes: Hyperscaler capex slows after AI boom; NVDA/white-box/in-house designs take share; campus penetration disappoints; Arista becomes a slow-growing cyclical with some margin compression.

evidence_for: FY2026 revenue guide raised three times in 2026 to $12.6B (+40%); within it AI fabrics goal >=$3.5B and campus goal >=$1.25B [Q2'26 earnings call 2026-08-04, primary].
Q2 2026: revenue $3,035.7M (+37.7% YoY, first $3B quarter); GAAP H1'26 op margin 44.1%, net margin 38.9%; gross margin 63.4% Q2 within 62-64% FY guide [10-Q income statement, confirm pass 80%].

Demand backlog visible: deferred revenue ~$6.9B (product deferrals +$600M QoQ on customer acceptance clauses = AI deployments in flight); $875.1M binding future-shipment obligations; RPO $6.1B at FY25 with ~90% recognizable in 2 years [10-Q s_0002_c11/12; 10-K s_0012_c43].
Supply secured: purchase commitments ~$9.7B (~3x YoY), memory secured for 2026 with visibility into 2027, liquid-cooling supply chain established [Q2'26 call, Ullal/Nightingale].

AI customer breadth: EtherLink AI fabrics >100 cumulative customers (from 4-5 in 2024); scale-across TAM forecast $15-20B by 2030 vs ~$3-4B in 2026, Arista capturing ~$1.2B in 2026 [Q2'26 call, Ullal].
EOS NetDL software stickiness demonstrated across top tier-1 cloud titans.
Ultra Ethernet Consortium (UEC) standardization solidifies multi-vendor Ethernet fabric traction.
evidence_against: Customer concentration ROSE: top-2 end customers 42% of FY2025 revenue (16% + 26%), up from 35% in FY2024 — the diversification thesis is not yet delivering [10-K s_0003_c09; confirm pass 80%].
Nvidia Spectrum-X bundling aggressively pushes full-stack networking alongside GPUs.
High trailing P/E (~58x) limits margin of safety on capex digestion shocks.
Guidance is supply-constrained, not demand-constrained: ~2 quarters of visibility; industry-wide component tightness expected to persist to ~2028 [Q2'26 call] — a supply slip hits revenue directly.
open_questions: What is the pace of optical migration from 800G DSP to 1.6T LPO/CPO?
Will enterprise/campus segment revenue diversify total revenue beyond 40% non-cloud?

predictions.claim: Arista reports AI-related revenue >= $1.5B in FY2025/2026 filings
predictions.notes: Resolved FALSE on review 2026-10-23: the FY2025 10-K and FY2026 10-Qs contain no AI-revenue line item (verified via filings adapter) — Arista discloses AI goals only in earnings calls/IR. The prediction was mis-specified (it bet on disclosure behavior, not operations). Superseded by anet-ai-fabrics-fy26, which resolves against the earnings-call goal.

predictions.claim: Combined revenue share of top 2 customers drops below 38% in FY2025 10-K
predictions.notes: Resolved FALSE 2026-10-23: FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-02-17) shows the two >10% end customers at 16% and 26% = 42% combined (10-K s_0003_c09, confirm pass 80%). Concentration rose from 35% (FY2024), not fell.

predictions.claim: Arista reports FY2026 AI fabrics revenue >= $3.5B (the goal stated by CFO Breithaupt on the Q2 2026 earnings call)
predictions.notes: Falsification driver for the ai-backend leg of the base-case driver build. Resolves on the Q4 2026 / FY2026 earnings call (~Feb 2027). CEO Ullal: 'we absolutely believe it will go up' — the risk is supply, not demand.

predictions.claim: Arista reports FY2026 campus revenue >= $1.25B (Q2 2026 earnings call goal)
predictions.notes: Falsification driver for the campus leg (15% CAGR assumption). Resolves on FY2026 reporting.

predictions.claim: Arista FY2026 revenue lands >= $12.6B (the thrice-raised full-year guide, +40%)
predictions.notes: Whole-build check: the guide anchors the FY2026 base from which all four drivers compound. Management says guidance is supply-constrained ('guiding based on what we are confident we can get the supply for'), so a miss signals supply failure, not demand.

predictions.claim: The FY2026 10-K (filed ~Feb 2027) discloses a third >=10% end customer beyond Microsoft and Meta
predictions.notes: CEO on Q2'26 call: 'I fully expect there to be one, maybe two 10% customers' beyond the two Ms; a potential >10% Q4 customer was flagged by analysts. Tests demand diversification beyond the top-2 (42% of FY2025 revenue).

decision_journal.situation: ANET trading at ~64x trailing P/E ($203.44) with forward P/E ~39x amid strong hyperscaler capex commitments.
alternatives_rejected: Trim position to under 2% portfolio weight due to high valuation multiples (rejected: operational momentum and backlog intact; Kelly scaled target still accommodates ~3% position).
Aggressive buy on recent dip (rejected: risk-reward margin of safety narrower above $200).

decision_journal.situation: Driver-model pilot (WO-4c): base scenario now carries a sourced four-driver revenue build (AI fabrics 45x0.2=9.0B + classic DC 6.2x1.11^4=9.4B + campus 1.25x1.15^4=2.2B + service 1.43x1.15^5=2.9B = $23.5B FY2030, 39% net margin, 1,276M shares -> derived EPS $7.18, ~21% CAGR from FY2025 EPS $2.74 — a cross-check ABOVE the scenario's 0.18, so the scenario params stay conservative and unchanged). Anchors verified this session: FY2025 revenue $9,005.7M (+28.6%), GM 64.1% [10-K, confirm 80%]; Q2'26 $3,035.7M (+37.7%), FY2026 guide raised 3x to $12.6B with AI fabrics >=$3.5B and campus >=$1.25B goals [Q2'26 call]. Two stale predictions resolved FALSE: anet-top2-cust-conc-fy25 (42% actual, concentration ROSE) and anet-ai-rev-fy25 (mis-specified — Arista never discloses AI revenue in SEC filings; superseded by anet-ai-fabrics-fy26 which resolves against the earnings-call goal).
alternatives_rejected: Raise base epsCagr from 0.18 toward the driver-implied ~0.21 (rejected: the driver build is one day old and its inputs rest on guidance-era anchors; let it survive one quarterly reconciliation before promoting it into scenario parameters).

Keep anet-ai-rev-fy25 open until its 2026-11-15 target date (rejected: the evidence is already dispositive — no AI-revenue line exists in either filing; leaving it open just defers a known-false resolution).
Add drivers to bull/bear scenarios too (rejected: pilot scope is ANET base only until it survives one reconciliation cycle, per WO-4c guardrail).
